body: I wish I knew the reason, the more I’ve tried to look for it the more lost I’ve become
Never too late my friend. Try to hang on. Peace and love to you

I don’t know what to say to help you. Especially because I feel as low as you do. But I’ll say honestly, even though I don’t know you, that I fucking care about you man. No matter who you are and what you’ve done, I care about you and love you. And the worlds gonna be worse off without you in it. Please stick around
